title: The amended engine's own signal alerts (Amendment F), TP1 +$13 before SL -$13, live forward test: B15's rule unchanged
status: APPROVED by the operator 2026-11-15; recorded from the first site run that carries Amendment F (the same merge ships the amended engine and this tracker)
approval: Operator, 2026-11-15 (chat), asked which pull requests to merge after being told that only #114 (engine fixes F1-F4) changes the forward-test freeze key and "would restart B15 and the forward arms from zero (old records are kept)": answered "All 13, including #114". Earlier the same day: "Merge all PRS before starting". Registered before the merge and before any B15b result exists.
partitions: live forward (new data only): alert plans whose signal bar closes at or after the first site run that carries Amendment F
source_of_hypothesis: B15-ENGINE-FWD measured the engine before Amendment F; Amendment F (audit/PREREGISTRATION.md) changes the engine (F1 weekly range; F3 / F2 calibration and EV vetoes no longer block a signal; F3b EV out of trade quality; F4 dead definitions), so B15's object ends at the merge with its record final. B15b asks B15's question of the amended engine. The offline impact replay (docs/audit/AMENDMENT_F_PROPOSAL.md section 4) kept every production signal on 15m-4h and about doubled the phone's ideas per day (0.36 to 0.80); signals the removed vetoes had blocked did not do worse on the live record (section 2), and none has shown an edge. No B15 result is pooled into B15b.

rule.stream: every plan the alerts open: a SIGNAL event of the amended treatment engine (freeze key 1f88aad357497da4:4440d52587f5cc6b) on 15m, 30m, 1h or 4h (ALERT_TFS), as published in the site payload; signals sent as REPEAT (same direction within 4 hours and $15 of an open plan, part A) open no plan and are not counted
rule.entry: the signal bar's close (the plan's entry), not the alert time; the alert-time price, delay and LATE flag are recorded beside it
rule.outcome: TP1 (+$13) before SL (-$13) from the entry: the plan's own result (quantum/notify.py), on the same feed's 5-minute bars when they cover the signal's close (a bar reaching both levels is a loss unless it opened beyond TP1), otherwise on the signal's own timeframe (recorded per trade)
rule.no_result: neither level within 3 days: EXPIRED, reported, not counted
rule.excluded: plans whose TP1 or SL is not $13 of price (the plan variables changed): reported, not counted

primary_test.looks: only when the number of decided results (TP1 or SL, in the order they resolved) first reaches 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100
primary_test.proven: at a look, the Wilson 95% lower bound of the TP1-first rate is above 51.0% (needs 21/30, 27/40, 33/50, 39/60, 44/70, 50/80, 56/90, 61/100): the B9-GRAB-FWD rule
primary_test.not_proven: not proven by 100 decided results, or by 2027-06-30, whichever comes first
primary_test.between_looks: the site and the reports show the running count and rate as COLLECTING, never a verdict

error_rates_stated_in_advance: Simulated (200,000 runs, independent trades): with no edge (true rate 50%) the rule says PROVEN 5.5% of the time (49%: 3.9%). A true 55% proves 22.6% of the time, 58% 41.5%, 60% 56.6%, 64% (the development estimate) 82.7%. NOT PROVEN means 'not confirmed', not 'proven absent'.
expected_pace: uncertain: the impact replay gave about 0.8 phone ideas a day on 15m and 1h (all alert timeframes open plans); at 3-8 decided results a week, 30 results take about 4-10 weeks; the deadline is B15's, 2027-06-30
secondary_reported_not_decisive: the rate by timeframe, by direction and by session
TP2 (+$20) reached after TP1 (the two-target plan, 2026-11-06), and the result in money at the plan after costs
the rate measured from the alert-time price instead of the bar close, and without LATE alerts
at the verdict: random 5-minute entries in the same directions over the same weeks
unchanged: B15's rule, looks, break-even and deadline; the alerts and the plan validation (this test reads the plans' recorded results only); B9-GRAB-FWD (continues, with Amendment F's dated note); B24 stays OFF
relation_to_B15: B15-ENGINE-FWD stops taking trades at B15b's start (quantum/notify.py: eng_run, ended = B15b's started_utc, saved once and never moved); signals before it that resolve later still count for B15. B15 ended before its first check, so it has no verdict. The two records are shown apart and never pooled.

decision.if_proven: Report it with the secondary checks and propose (never adopt automatically) that the phone receive the engine's signals as the confirmed stream. Still not a guarantee: a PROVEN rate is an average, and any single trade can lose.
decision.if_not_proven: The engine-signal lead is closed for the alerts; recorded in research/trials.jsonl and the write-up. No re-run with changed distances, timeframes or filters on the same data.
